exceptions.text: unresolved executable source: f'{broken} echo RAN; else echo SKIPPED; fi'
exceptions.necessity: The test executes conditions extracted from the checked Makefile against a deliberately broken gate to prove the guard still runs. Its executable argument is derived test input, bound to the complete consumer AST digest.
exceptions.alternative: Replacing execution with a text assertion would miss a condition that silently skips the guard. Literal duplication would stop testing the actual recipe.
exceptions.removal: Remove when the Make recipe extraction can be reconstructed by the executable-payload adapter without granting arbitrary input.

exceptions.text: -- Query __expression____expression__
exceptions.necessity: Each TPC-DS stream query carries a per-query label line in its SQL; the label is emitted output that identifies the query in stream SQL and logs. Changing it changes generated stream SQL.
exceptions.alternative: Emit the label outside the SQL text, which changes the stream output format and needs a separate reviewed change.
exceptions.removal: Remove when stream labels are emitted outside the SQL text.

exceptions.text: -- Note: PARTITIONED BY clause should be added with column types
exceptions.payload:
__expression__
-- Note: PARTITIONED BY clause should be added with column types
exceptions.necessity: The Athena DDL generator emits this note in generated DDL when partitioning is requested, telling the user that the PARTITIONED BY clause still needs column types. It is user-facing output, not source prose.
exceptions.alternative: Generate a complete PARTITIONED BY clause, which changes generated DDL and needs a separate reviewed change.
exceptions.removal: Remove when the generator emits a complete PARTITIONED BY clause.

The test exercises that runtime-built command; the fixture is bound to a digest of the test and the module code it reads.
exceptions.alternative: Rewrite the subprocess input as a static literal the checker can parse; that changes the test and was not taken in the cleanup.
exceptions.removal: Remove when the test's subprocess input becomes a static literal or the executable-payload adapter can reconstruct it.

exceptions.text: unresolved executable source: sys.executable
exceptions.necessity: The local review must drop the secret environment variables from its own process image so no ancestor of the reviewer holds them. Replacing the process with itself is the only way to discard the initial environment block; the arguments are the interpreter's own original argument vector.
exceptions.alternative: Spawning a child leaves the parent, with the secrets in its environment, as an ancestor of the reviewer.
exceptions.removal: Remove when the executable-payload adapter can resolve process replacement calls statically.

exceptions.text: unresolved executable source: argv[0]
exceptions.necessity: The bootstrap hands the process to the pinned uv launcher so no extra Python process stays in the reviewer's ancestry. argv is built by review_command() from fixed tokens and the review options, with no inline source.
exceptions.alternative: Running uv as a child would keep the bootstrap process, with the caller's environment, as an ancestor of the reviewer.
exceptions.removal: Remove when the executable-payload adapter can resolve process replacement calls statically.
